summary: Two bird checklists with ranks (Clements, IOC) are openly available through GBIF with CC BY 4.0, so taxa ranked differently can be listed; GBIF occurrences give geography for birds and Lepidoptera. No dataset records subspecies-level range overlap or sessile comparison taxa, and Avibase, the best cross-walk of concepts, was blocked (403).
next_step: Diff Clements vs IOC species/subspecies ranks, pull GBIF occurrences per disputed pair, and pre-register a sympatry metric and effort correction; add a sessile comparison group.
obstacles_confirmed: Allopatry is itself a criterion for ranking forms (circularity)
No uniform encoding of taxonomic disagreement
Mobile-animal scope covered well only for birds
